caption: The drawing features an arrangement of vertical stripes in alternating pastel colors, including shades of blue, red, tan, and off-white. Overlying the stripes is an intricate, symmetrical decorative pattern rendered in fine lines. The central portion of the design contains a circular medallion with a clover-shaped motif at its core, surrounded by ornate, radiating shapes and flourishes comprised of curved and leaf-like elements. The border of the pattern extends outward with repeated curves and filigree details, aligning with the overall symmetry. The texture in the background appears slightly lined or grid-like, giving a woven effect. At the bottom left of the drawing, the words “CAPITOL COVERLID” are printed, while the lower right bears a handwritten signature.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
